newsitem.title: UK: B.A.T chief says no value in demerger.
newsitem.headline: B.A.T chief says no value in demerger.

text.p: Tobacco and financial services group B.A.T Industries Plc chief executive Martin Broughton said on Wednesday that a recent strategy review showed there was no value to be generated from a demerger of the company.
He told Reuters, "The review showed there was no value we could see that would be generated from a demerger."
Broughton told analysts the company was not "obsessed by retaining the current structure", nor by demerger.
But if it could be shown to improve cashflow, then the company would consider such a move, he said.

B.A.T's share price has been dogged by concern over tobacco litigation in the U.S., and Broughton conceded that "the dominant issue affecting share price for B.A.T Industries is U.S. litigation, regulation and indeed science."
